messages:
Priya Das: Seeing repeated tail-latency spikes in apac-east dedicated pool for the last 22m. P95 token latency up to 1.8s and bursts coincide with high egress on a handful of tenants.
Alex Chen: ugh. any noisy-tenant ids yet?
Priya Das: digging now — looks like tenant T-9423 and T-1097 are top egress hitters. charts: https://grafana.redwood/alert/edge-egress?panelId=22
Samir Patel: are these single-tenant Dedicated slices or shared?
Priya Das: both are on fractional dedicated slices (shared NIC). The NIC egress queue fills and we see packet drops -> retransmits -> tail latency.
Jules: can we temporarily carve a burst-lane (isolated egress bw) for the offending tenants while we investigate? low-risk option: egress shaper at T-9423 to 200Mbps for 15m.
Alex Chen: +1 for a short shaper. also let's consider migrating T-1097 to an alternate AZ with spare capacity if shaping causes SLA complaints.
Samir Patel: cost note: migrating incurs double-provisioning for ~30m; shaping is cheaper but might affect throughput. we should surface to CS before doing anything that might hit customers.
Priya Das: agreed. I'll open a CS ping and propose shaping + a canary migration window.
infra-bot: [Alert] pool-apac-east-dedicated-3: egress-queue-depth > 90% (22m). triggered at 1758889957.
Priya Das: quick sanity check — running allocation query to list live slices:
```
rdctl allocations list --pool apac-east-dedicated-3 --format json | jq '.[] | {tenant,egress_mbps,current_allocs}'
```
Priya Das: output shows T-9423 egress_mbps=420, T-1097=380, others < 60.
Jules: ok schedule: 1) apply 200Mbps shaper to T-9423 for 15m 2) monitor p95 and egress queue 3) if no regression, plan a 30m migration for T-1097 to apac-east-b with gentle ramp.
Alex Chen: who can apply the shaper? I can push the shaper policy, but need someone to approve CS message.
Samir Patel: I'll draft the CS note, include expected impact and rollback plan. Priya - can you paste the short runbook text?
Priya Das: runbook in short: 
- apply egress-shaper tenant=T-9423 limit=200Mbps duration=15m
- watch grafana panel (p95 tokens, egress-queue) and infra-alerts for 10m
- if p95 drops < 600ms and egress queue < 70% -> keep shaping off, schedule migration for T-1097
- if p95 reverts or other tenants spike -> rollback shaper immediately and escalate to #eng-oncall

Samir Patel: LGTM. tagging @CS for awareness in the message.
Jules: also add a note to check NIC driver telemetry for retransmit rates (might be firmware-related).
Priya Das: on it. I'll apply the shaper in 3m and post results.
Alex Chen: thanks. if shaping helps, follow-up: evaluate permanent fractional carveouts or dedicated egress lanes on the pool. Samir can run cost model later.
Priya Das: shaper applied at 1758890005. will report back in 5m. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Short incident thread: tail-latency spikes in apac-east dedicated pool caused by high tenant egress. Team agrees to apply temporary egress shaping to offending tenant, notify CS, monitor, and plan migration if shaping mitigates the issue. Infra bot alerted queue depth.
